sources.label: Current structured chest loot and fixed pools

item.name: Common Chest
item.cardSummary: A low-cost starter chest with two global pulls: one material and one decoration.
item.acquisition: Buy from the Shop with Gold.
item.dropSummary: Global random pools: material pulls choose Wood Block or Fabric Block at 25% each, Stone Block at 15%, or Wood Rod, Stone Rod, Wedge, Truss, or Corner Wedge at 7% each. Decoration pulls choose Seat at 40%, or Step or Window at 30% each. There is no ability pool.
item.restrictedLoot: If the game uses gambling-restricted chest mode, the fixed set is Wood Block x1 and Wood Rod x1. This is not the universal global reward.

item.name: Uncommon Chest
item.cardSummary: A step above Common with four material pulls and one decoration pull, but no ability pull.
item.useCase: Early material stock and simple boat parts
item.acquisition: Buy from the Shop with Gold.
item.dropSummary: Global random pools: material pulls choose Rusted Block at 35%, Metal Block at 25%, Glass Block, Plastic Block, or Grass Block at 11% each, or Wedge, Truss, Corner Wedge, Rusted Rod, Metal Rod, Wood Rod, or Stone Rod at 1% each. Decoration pulls choose Step, Seat, I-Beam, Helm, Window, Mast, Chair, Torch, Door, or Hatch at 10% each. There is no ability pool.
item.restrictedLoot: If the game uses gambling-restricted chest mode, the fixed set is Rusted Block x2, Metal Block x2, Truss x1, and Step x1. This is not the universal global reward.

item.name: Rare Chest
item.cardSummary: The first permanent tier with an ability pull, pairing twelve material pulls with two decoration pulls.
item.useCase: Adding ability parts to a growing build
item.acquisition: Buy from the Shop with Gold.
item.dropSummary: Global random pools: material pulls choose Concrete Block at 35%, Marble Block at 25%, Ice Block or Sand Block at 15% each, or Concrete Rod, Marble Rod, Rusted Rod, Metal Rod, or Truss at 2% each. Decoration pulls choose Door, Hatch, Helm, or Chair at 13% each, or Flag, I-Beam, Mast, or Torch at 12% each. Ability pulls choose Cannon, Switch, or Piston at 17% each, or Balloon Block, Glue, or Hinge at 16% each.
item.restrictedLoot: If the game uses gambling-restricted chest mode, the fixed set is Concrete Block x5, Marble Block x5, Flag x1, Mast x1, Chair x1, and Torch x2. This is not the universal global reward.

item.name: Epic Chest
item.cardSummary: A high-pull progression tier with thirty-eight material pulls, four decoration pulls, and two ability pulls.
item.useCase: Building a larger supply of higher-tier materials and abilities
item.acquisition: Buy from the Shop with Gold.
item.dropSummary: Global random pools: material pulls choose Concrete Block or Coal Block at 35% each, Titanium Block at 20%, Concrete Rod at 4%, or Marble Rod or Titanium Rod at 3% each. Decoration pulls choose Flag, Chair, Lamp, or Sign at 17% each, or Locked Door or Throne at 16% each. Ability pulls choose Cannon, Button, Switch, or Balloon Block at 13% each, or Glue, Piston, Hinge, or Thruster at 12% each.
item.restrictedLoot: If the game uses gambling-restricted chest mode, the fixed set is Titanium Block x15, Concrete Block x15, Window x8, Helm x1, Throne x1, Door x1, Hatch x1, Cannon x3, and Switch x1. This is not the universal global reward.

item.name: Legendary Chest
item.cardSummary: The highest permanent shop tier, with the largest global pools and Harpoon among its listed ability drops.
item.useCase: Late progression when you want the widest high-tier pull pools
item.acquisition: Buy from the Shop with Gold.
item.dropSummary: Global random pools: material pulls choose Brick Block at 40%, Titanium Block at 35%, or Obsidian Block at 25%. Decoration pulls choose Locked Door, Throne, Lamp, or Sign at 25% each. Ability pulls choose Cannon at 12%, or Glue, Button, Switch, Piston, Balloon Block, Hinge, Thruster, or Harpoon at 11% each.
item.restrictedLoot: If the game uses gambling-restricted chest mode, the fixed set is Obsidian Block x50, Titanium Block x50, Glass Block x25, Lamp x3, Locked Door x1, Throne x1, Sign x1, Balloon Block x10, Cannon x4, Glue x2, Piston x2, Button x1, Switch x1, Thruster x1, and Harpoon x1. This is not the universal global reward.
